rules.statement: Where a judgment-debtor re-enters an open land two days after the execution of a proprietary decree, such subsequent re-entry does not amount to a hindrance offered to the judgment-creditor in taking complete and effectual possession within the meaning of section 325 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where, two days after execution of a proprietary decree in respect of a land, the judgment-debtor re-entered the land (which was an open one)- Held , that the subsequent re-entry by the judgment-debtor did not amount to a hindrance offered to the judgment-creditor in taking complete and effectual possession within the meaning of section 325 of the Civil Procedure Code."
